title: Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
MITE Technology is a technology solutions provider specializing in IT consulting, software development, digital marketing, media production, and business automation. We help businesses grow through innovative, technology-driven solutions that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen digital presence, and drive sustainable growth. We foster a creative and collaborative environment that encourages innovation, continuous learning, and the adoption of emerging technologies.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Digital Marketing Specialist role based in Palghat. The Digital Marketing Specialist will plan, execute, and optimize digital campaigns across multiple online channels to support product launches, brand awareness, and lead generation. Daily activities include managing social media profiles, creating and scheduling content, monitoring campaign performance, and using web analytics tools to track and report on key metrics. The role also involves coordinating online promotions, collaborating with design and development teams to ensure consistent digital branding, and recommending data-driven improvements to marketing strategies. The specialist will engage with internal stakeholders and clients, ensuring clear communication of campaign goals, timelines, and outcomes.

**Qualifications**

Candidates must have a minimum of
**4+ years of professional experience in Digital Marketing and Online Marketing**
, with proven expertise in planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns.

Strong expertise in
**Social Media Marketing**
, including content planning, scheduling, community management, audience engagement, and platform-specific optimization.

A strong
**creative mindset with innovative thinking capabilities**
, demonstrating the ability to develop engaging content, creative campaigns, and effective marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.

Ability to stay updated with
**emerging digital marketing trends, social media trends, platform algorithms, and evolving audience behaviour**
, incorporating relevant trends into marketing campaigns.

Hands-on experience in
**integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into digital marketing workflows**
, including AI-powered content creation, audience research, campaign optimization, marketing automation, and performance analysis.

Proficiency in
**digital marketing tools and platforms**
, including AI-powered tools, social media management platforms, analytics dashboards, content creation tools, SEO/SEM tools, email marketing platforms, and marketing automation solutions, with the ability to use them efficiently to improve productivity and campaign performance.

Strong knowledge of
**Web Analytics and Performance Marketing**
, including KPI tracking, campaign performance analysis, reporting, and data-driven strategy optimization.

Excellent
**written and verbal communication skills**
, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate marketing ideas clearly.

Knowledge of
**SEO/SEM, email marketing, CRM platforms, lead generation, and conversion optimization**
is highly desirable.

A bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field is preferred, along with relevant professional experience in digital marketing.

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, creative problem-solving abilities, and the capacity to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Familiarity with the
**IT, technology, or software solutions industry**
is an advantage, particularly in marketing technology-driven products and services.

title: Marketing And Sales Executive

ALIGN UNIVERSAL has been providing dependable power solutions to businesses across Kerala since 1999. Starting as a modest generator repair shop, the company has grown into a trusted partner for over 400 customers in the region. title: Marketing Manager
description:
Role Overview\*

The Marketing Manager will develop and execute marketing strategies for LDX Media’s digital advertising network and HEPTA’s LED display solutions. The role involves defining how each brand approaches the market, identifying customer segments, strengthening brand visibility, managing social media and generating qualified leads for the sales team.

\*Key Responsibilities\*

- \*Marketing strategy:\* Develop marketing plans with clear objectives, target audiences, campaign schedules and budgets for each business unit.

- \*Market approach:\* Define which customer segments to approach, the value proposition to communicate and the most effective channels to reach decision-makers.

- \*Market research:\* Study customer needs, competitors and industry trends to identify opportunities and improve brand positioning.

- \*Lead generation:\* Plan targeted campaigns through digital advertising, email outreach, industry partnerships, events and other relevant channels.

- \*Social media management:\* Manage company social media accounts, prepare content calendars, oversee publishing and engagement, and monitor performance.

- \*Content and creative direction:\* Brief and coordinate designers, video creators and external agencies to produce effective advertisements, brochures, presentations, case studies and promotional materials.

- \*Sales support:\* Work with the sales team to develop pitches, campaign packages and marketing materials suited to different customer segments.

- \*Website and digital presence:\* Keep website content current and coordinate improvements in search visibility, enquiries and lead conversion.

- \*Campaign execution:\* Oversee marketing campaigns from planning to completion, ensuring timely delivery and consistent brand communication.

- \*Performance reporting:\* Track campaign results, qualified leads, cost per lead and contribution to sales. Use findings to refine the marketing approach.

- \*Budget management:\* Allocate marketing expenditure effectively and evaluate returns from campaigns and external service providers.

\*Qualifications and Experience\*

- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications or a related field; an MBA in Marketing is preferred.

- Minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience, including responsibility for marketing strategy and campaign execution.

- Experience in B2B marketing, advertising, media, display solutions or related sectors is preferred.

- Practical knowledge of social media management, paid digital campaigns, content marketing and analytics.

- Strong communication, planning, creative briefing and coordination skills.

- Ability to translate marketing plans into measurable business results.

\*Key Performance Indicators\*

- Qualified leads generated and their conversion into sales opportunities.

- Marketing contribution to the sales pipeline.

- Campaign performance and cost efficiency.

- Growth in relevant social media reach and engagement.

- Website enquiries and lead conversion.

* - Timely execution of marketing plans within approved budgets.
